chunks: And whatever was in it from ʿAmr ibn Thābit, who is ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār and al-Ḥasan ibn Muttayl together, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from al-Ḥakam ibn Miskīn, from ʿAmr ibn Thābit Abī al-Miqdām.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Together; indicates joint transmission from two narrators
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author's act of narrating through a chain
key_terms.عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي الْمِقْدَامِ: The identified narrator, clarifying who ʿAmr ibn Thābit is

ai.seo_question: What is the chain of transmission to ʿAmr ibn Thābit in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ʿAmr ibn Thābit, identified here as ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and preserving the route of attribution in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
